name: Ernesto Simpson
description: '''Ernesto Simpson''' (born 10 March 1964) is a Cuban drummer of [[World music|world]], [[jazz]], [[Afro-Caribbean music|Afro-Caribbean]], [[Music of African heritage in Cuba|Afro-Cuban]], [[Latin music|Latin]], and [[funk]] music. He is [[Grammy Awards|Grammy]]-nominated and internationally acclaimed, with over thirty years of performing, recording, touring, teaching, and [[Session musician|session work]] alongside some the greatest names in the industry.
